report.title: Report {{target}}

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: You won’t be able to message each other and you won’t see their listings. You can unblock at any time.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty_body: New messages, listing reviews and reminders will show up here.
notifications.login_body: Log in to get updates about your messages and listings.

prefs.title: Push notifications
prefs.subtitle: Choose what shows on your lock screen. The in-app list stays complete.
prefs.lost_found_hint: A post matches what you are looking for
prefs.commitment: Only about your messages, listings, groups, badges and lost items. No ads.

notifications.system_off: Notifications for this app are turned off in your phone settings.

permission.title: Turn on notifications?
permission.body: Know right away when someone messages you or your listing is approved.
permission.headline: Don't miss what matters
permission.on_body: Notifications appear on your lock screen for the types you choose below.
permission.denied_tip: Open your phone's Settings → Notifications → turn them on for this app.

profile.title: Profile
profile.no_listings: This person has no active listings.
profile.public_subtitle: Public info · phone number never shown
profile.own_notice: This is your public profile — others see it exactly like this.
profile.blocked_notice: You blocked this person. Their listings and groups are hidden from you.
profile.safety_tip: Meet in busy places like the factory gate or canteen. Don't send money before seeing the item or meeting in person.

badge_request.title: Verification badges
badge_request.intro: Badges help others trust you. Documents are only seen by moderators and deleted after 30 days.
badge_request.doc_hint_worker: Employee card or labour contract (you may cover your ID number).
badge_request.doc_hint_landlord: Property papers or a rental contract.
badge_request.doc_hint_venue: Business licence of the venue, or a photo of you at its sign.
badge_request.doc_hint_employer: Business licence or a company introduction letter.
badge_request.pick_photo: Take or choose a photo of the document
badge_request.submitted: Submitted. You will hear back within 1–2 days.
badge_request.camera_denied: Camera access is off. Turn it on in your phone settings or choose a photo from your library.
badge_request.subtitle: Get verified so others feel safe dealing with you.
badge_request.summary_hint: Add badges so your posts and groups look more trustworthy.
badge_request.benefit_visible: Shown next to your name on your profile, posts and groups.
badge_request.benefit_trust: Buyers, renters and job seekers feel safer contacting you.
badge_request.benefit_free: Free. A moderator checks your document and tells you the result.
badge_request.choose_hint: Tap a badge you don't have yet to send a document.
badge_request.for_worker: For people working in the industrial zone: workers, engineers, contractors.
badge_request.for_landlord: For owners of boarding rooms, rooms or houses for rent.
badge_request.for_venue: For owners of football, badminton or pickleball courts.
badge_request.for_employer: For companies, workshops and shops that are hiring.
badge_request.upload_hint: A clear photo, up to {{mb}} MB.
badge_request.tip_name: Your name and the company or address can be read.
badge_request.tip_cover: You may cover your ID number, birth date and hometown.
badge_request.privacy_body: It is stored privately, seen only by moderators to grant the badge, and deleted {{days}} days after the decision.
badge_request.nothing_to_request: You have sent or already own every badge. We'll let you know the results.
badge_request.need_photo: Add a photo of the document to send.

account.delete_body: Your listings, groups and profile are hidden immediately and permanently deleted after 30 days. Sent messages are kept anonymously. This cannot be undone.
account.delete_warning_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
account.delete_warning_body: Your account is hidden immediately and permanently deleted after 30 days. This cannot be undone.
account.delete_item_profile_body: Your profile, photo and verification badges are hidden from everyone right away and deleted after 30 days.
account.delete_item_listings_body: All your listings are hidden right away; listings and photos are deleted after 30 days.
account.delete_item_groups_body: Open groups you host are cancelled; you leave groups you joined or asked to join.
account.delete_item_messages_body: After 30 days, messages you sent are kept anonymously so other people’s conversations stay intact.
account.delete_grace_body: As soon as you confirm, you are signed out, stop receiving notifications and nobody can see your account. After 30 days your data is permanently deleted, as required by Decree 13/2023 on personal data protection.

coach.label: Quick tour
coach.search_body: Type an item, a room or a job into the search box at the top.
coach.post_body: Tap the Post (+) button in the middle of the bottom bar to sell items, rent a room or hire.
coach.chat_body: Messages with buyers and sellers are in the Messages tab — no need to share your phone number.
